facts.canRepresentV2KeyWithoutPhysicalRow: Technically yes (text PK, no FK), but it would be a projection/cache row, not an identity registry

packetIdentityRegistry.reasoning: It is a per-packet runtime/projection registry mirroring atlas_packets 1:1 and keyed by the same physical key. Making it the owner of canonical logical identity would mix OWNER with PROJECTION/CACHE columns. Reuse would need repository and kind columns and a redefinition of its key, which is a schema extension that changes its role.
packetIdentityRegistry.decisionNeeded: Whether the alias target should be (a) a new narrow packet-identity table, (b) an extension of atlas_packet_registry, or (c) built on the stable-file identity model. Operator direction says reuse if possible; the audit says it is not canonical as-is.
